map.SCL-90 是广泛用于心理健康筛查的自评量表，包含 90 个项目、10 个症状: SCL-90 is a widely used self-report screening instrument for mental health. It contains 90 items covering 10 symptom factors (somatization, obsessive-compulsive, interpersonal sensitivity, depression, anxiety, hostility, phobic anxiety, paranoid ideation, psychoticism and other), plus a total score and the number of positive items. The result helps you quickly locate the aspects worth attention; it is a reference only and cannot replace a professional diagnosis.
map.五级李克特自评（从无到严重）: Five-level Likert self-rating (from none to severe)
map.自动计算各因子分、总均分与阳性项目数: Automatically computes each factor score, the mean of factors and the number of positive items
map.标出偏高因子，提示可关注方向: Flag the elevated factors and point out the areas worth attention
map.结果可保存与复测对比: Results can be saved and compared on retest
map.自我心理健康筛查与觉察: Self-screening and self-awareness for mental health
map.咨询或就诊前的初步整理: A first pass of organisation before a consultation or clinic visit
map.长期观察自身状态变化: Watch your own state over the long run
map.按\"最近一周\"的真实感受对每题打分: Score each item by how you actually felt in the last week
map.完成全部 90 题后查看因子与总分: Finish all 90 items to see the factor scores and the total
map.看哪些因子分相对偏高: See which factor scores are relatively high
map.结合具体条目理解偏高含义: Understand what a high result means against the specific item
map.如持续困扰，前往正规机构咨询: If the distress persists, consult a proper institution
map.以\"最近一周\"为时间视角作答，避免泛化: Answer with the last week as the time frame to avoid vague generalisations
map.因子分高只提示困扰方向，不代表确诊: A high factor score only points to the direction of distress; it is not a diagnosis
map.关注连续偏高的因子而非单题波动: Watch factors that stay elevated rather than single-item fluctuations
map.把它当作觉察工具，而非自我贴标签: Treat it as a tool for self-awareness, not for labelling yourself
map.SCL-90 能诊断心理疾病吗？: Can SCL-90 diagnose a mental illness?
map.不能。它只是自评筛查工具，用于发现可能需要关注的倾向，最终诊断必须由精神科或临床: No. It is only a self-screening tool that surfaces tendencies worth attention; the final diagnosis must be made by a psychiatrist or clinical psychologist using interviews and examinations.
map.总分或因子分多少算偏高？: At what total or factor score is a result considered high?
map.常参考总均分与因子分：单项因子分或总均分超过约 2 分提示该方面困扰较明显，超过: The total mean and the factor scores are commonly used: a single factor score or the total mean above about 2 points indicates fairly noticeable distress in that area, and above 3 points indicates heavier distress that warrants further professional assessment.
map.结果偏高该怎么办？: What should I do if the result is high?
map.先不必恐慌，筛查高分不等于患病。可关注具体偏高的因子，调整作息与压力，若持续困扰: No need to panic straight away — a high screening score does not mean you are ill. Look at which factors are elevated and adjust your sleep routine and stress levels; if the distress persists or affects daily life, consider consulting the psychology or psychiatry department of a proper hospital.
